collection.title: Citroen C3 Hatchback 2009 to 2016 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Citroen C3 Hatchback 2009 to 2016 model requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 16" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Bayonet arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, we also have rear wiper blades for this C3 Hatchback - simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
